name: FTX-1 Optima
title: Yaesu FTX-1 Optima
summary: FTX-1 Field Head bundled with SPA-1 100 W amp: HF–70cm all-mode incl. C4FM, base or portable.

f.receiver_arch: SDR (Yaesu, arch not specified by DXE)
f.power_source: 13.8 VDC external (100 W via SPA-1) or internal battery (6 W)
f.battery: SBR-52LI 10.8V 6400 mAh Li-ion (included; swaps with SPA-1 on Field Head)

extra.variant: Optima = Field Head + SPA-1 amp + battery; Field = head + battery only (6/10 W)
extra.atu_note: DXE: internal HF tuner yes (in SPA-1 amp)
extra.power_note: VHF/UHF 50 W with SPA-1 (model knowledge); 10 W on 13.8 V without amp, 6 W on battery

gotchas: Optima vs Field: Optima adds the SPA-1 100 W amp (+ATU); ysu-ftx-1field is head+battery only (6/10 W) for ~$500 less
Needs a separate 13.8 V ~21 A supply for 100 W; battery mode drops to 6 W (amp removed)
DXE lists single receiver, no dual watch — ysu-ftdx-101d / ico-ic-7610-32 for true dual RX on HF
Digital voice is C4FM only — no D-STAR; ico-ic-705 covers D-STAR in a QRP portable
Li-ion pack: DXE only accepts returns in person at a retail store
best_for: one radio for home 100 W and battery POTA/SOTA
not_for: budget buyers who only need QRP (Field model)

pairs.why: same Field Head without the amp, QRP-only
C4FM mobile companion for the car
